purpose: Explicit, reviewable sign-off for breaking OpenAPI contract changes. scripts/api_contract_check.py baseline-check fails on any breaking finding that is not listed here.
how_to_use: 2. Copy the printed 'id:' of each breaking finding you intend to ship.

3. Add one entry per accepted id with owner, reason, approved_by, affected_consumers, migration_plan, and an unexpired expires_at. Record real human acceptance; all six fields are enforced for matching entries.
4. Run: python scripts/api_contract_check.py baseline-update, and commit the refreshed snapshots in the same pull request.
5. After the pull request merges the change becomes part of the base-branch baseline, so delete the entry again; baseline-check reports leftover entries as unused.
id_format: <surface>|<kind>|<METHOD /path>|<target>. Replace <surface> with '*' to cover the same change on both the default and full surfaces with one entry.
